items.title: Hamm’s Continental Buys Half Of Mercuria’s Argentina Oil Play
items.summary: Billionaire shale pioneer Harold Hamm’s Continental Resources Inc. signed agreements to buy half of an Argentinian shale oil firm owned by Mercuria Energy Group, with the firms promising more than $4 billion of investment to expand production.

items.title: Oil Giants Eye Jurassic Rocks off Mexico in Search of Bonanza
items.summary: Latin America’s two biggest oil companies are betting big on a high-risk effort to unlock a vast trove of crude from rocks that haven’t seen the light of day in 160 million years.

items.title: Exxon Warns Kazakhstan’s Top Oil Field to Peak Within Years
items.summary: ExxonMobil Holdings Corp. has told Kazakhstan that the nation’s top oil field is already on the cusp of peak output and that its production will slump sharply in the coming decade.
